title: Assess declared architectural allocation consistency
description: Compare the declared architectural responsibilities of applicable Allocated Requirements and constrained Functions under identified allocation rules, exposing factual violations, explicit deferrals, and questions requiring engineering review.
inputs: Selected model state with AR, Function, and Module identities and allocation/constraint relationships.
Declared allocation and consistency rules, including permitted deferrals.
outputs: Findings with subject identities, allocation paths, rule basis, and assessed scope.
Distinguished consistent, violated, deferred, incomplete, or engineering-review-needed conclusions.
behavior: Identify the applicable ARs, Functions, constraints, and accountable allocations in the selected scope.
Expose absent or unresolved responsibilities and preserve explicit permitted deferrals.
Compare converging responsibilities under the selected rules; do not assume every Function and AR pair must share one Module.
Associate each mechanically established conflict with its deciding rule and supporting paths.
Present undecidable allocation adequacy as a review need rather than manufactured consistency or conflict.

failure_behavior.condition: The architecture or needed constraint relation is absent.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the unassessed or incomplete scope rather than complete architectural consistency.

failure_behavior.condition: An allocation endpoint is unresolved or of the wrong type.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the broken responsibility path and prevent reliance on it as a confirmed allocation.

failure_behavior.condition: No declared rule decides whether differing responsibilities are acceptable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the difference for engineering review without claiming a mechanical violation.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: IR-002 / SR-010 confirms allocation assessment; IR-005 / SR-014 constrains the boundary between factual conformance and engineering judgment.
